selector.hint_full: Not the whole screen? Select the area with the mouse · Esc: cancel
selector.hint_icons: Point at an icon to see its name
selector.hint_short: Corners and edges: resize · inside: move

selector.tr_hint_first_short: Draw around a piece · Esc: finish
selector.tr_hint_next: Translation mode: draw around the next piece · Esc: finish

selector.tr_hint_next_short: Draw around the next piece · Esc: finish
selector.win_need_update: To see all windows, update the ClipSD extension for GNOME
selector.win_need_install: To see all windows, install the ClipSD extension for GNOME
selector.win_relogin: The extension is updated: log out and back in to see all windows
selector.win_closed: Could not capture the whole window: the screenshot shows what was visible on the screen
selector.win_min_failed_sub: Restore it and take the screenshot again
selector.win_offscreen: This window is off the screen now
selector.win_slow: GNOME is answering slowly: not all windows are listed yet

selector.win_visible_only: The window is covered by others: only its visible part will be captured here
